collectorNotes:
The vendor numbers come from the benchmark table data inside the model page's JS bundle (https://www.stepfun.com/assets/index-Cp9oF7Fw.js), because the page renders client-side. Column order: Step 5 Preview (High), GLM-5.3 (Max), Kimi K3 (Max), GPT-6 Astra (Max), Claude Fable 5.1 (Max), Claude Opus 5 (Max).

Several rows are probably cited from Artificial Analysis, but the page only credits AA for GDPval-AA. For TB v4, HLE, SciCode, CritPt, GDP.pdf and AA-LCR, the AA source is inferred because the other models' numbers in those rows match AA's. Those rows are recorded as official vendor numbers.

The Chinese news article image shows GDPval-AA v2 = 1571 (as of Sep 19). The model page shows v2.1 = 1566 (as of Sep 20). Both are recorded.

No Step 5 Preview entry appears on these boards: tbench.ai TB4 / Science, DeepSWE (Datacurve, updated 2026-09-22), FrontierSWE, Toolathlon, the ALE API data, the Scale HLE board, OSWorld-v2 or CritPt. The Zapier board only shows the top 10 in its HTML; the rest load client-side, so this model's presence there could not be checked.

The vendor table does not include FrontierCode, FrontierSWE or OSWorld 2. Other vendors' comparison tables print no Step 5 Preview numbers in the leads (no vendor_comparison).
verifierSummary: 15 条记录全部核实无误（confirmed）。stepfun.com/step-5-preview 和 /news/step-5-preview 都是前端渲染的单页应用，表格数据不在 HTML 里，而是写在打包的 JS 文件 https://www.stepfun.com/assets/index-Cp9oF7Fw.js 中。从这个文件里找到了完整的对比表（列为 Step 5 Preview (High), GLM-5.3 (Max), Kimi K3 (Max), GPT-6 Astra (Max), Claude Fable 5.1 (Max), Claude Opus 5 (Max)），#0、#2-#6、#8-#10、#12-#14 的数值与原文逐字一致。另外两段原文也已核对：DeepSWE 的 SWE-agent harness 加 temperature=1.0/top_p=0.95 说明，以及 GDPval-AA v2.1 注明 "as of Sep. 20, 2026" 的说明。HLE w/ tools‡ 的脚注原文为 "Step 5 Preview (High) and GLM-5.3 (Max) were evaluated on the text-only subset"。#11 来自新闻稿 slug step-5-preview（2026-09-20）的配图 step-5-preview-img03 中的 GDPval-AA v2 图表，Step 5 Preview (High) 为 1571；同稿引用块写有"GDPval-AA v2 采用 Artificial Analysis 截至 2026 年 9 月 19 日公布的最新结果"。#1 和 #7 的 Vals 榜单行与原文一致：TB4 页注明 Updated 10/7/2026，所有结果为 avg@3；TBS 页注明 Updated 10/8/2026，版本 v0.1。模型页 vals.ai/models/stepfun_step-5-preview 写明 Default Provider: Stepfun, Temperature: 1, Top P: 0.95。仍属推断、未经证实的有三点：HLE(无工具)、SciCode、CritPt、GDP.pdf、TB v4 这几行是否由 AA 跑出，官方页没有注明；无工具 HLE 行没有脚注说明是纯文本子集，matchesPreferred=false 依据的是"与 AA 数值一致"的推断；ALE-CLI 用的是 Pass 还是 Score 口径也没有注明，但它只是 CLI 子集，不论哪种口径都应标 comparable=false。
